### **1. Arjun "Theek hai." aur "Dekhta hoon." se asal mein kya feel aur communicate kar raha hai? Woh kya NAHI keh raha?**

Arjun ke responses gham aur stress ki wajah se emotional shutdown ki ek classic example hain. Woh sirf information nahi de raha; woh apni energy conserve kar raha hai aur boundaries set kar raha hai.

**Arjun kya communicate kar raha hai:**

*   **"Theek hai."**: Ye "Theek hai" ya "Good" ka koi enthusiastic jawab nahi hai. Ye ek flat aur low-energy acknowledgement hai. Woh communicate kar raha hai:
